newsitem.title: USA: Coastal Physician to sell $17 mln in assets.
newsitem.headline: Coastal Physician to sell $17 mln in assets.

text.p: Coastal Physician Group Inc said Monday it had executed a definitive agreement to sell certain assets of its Physicians Planning Group Inc unit to HelixCare Properties Llc, an affiliate of Helix Health Inc of Maryland.
Coastal said it expects to realize about $17 million in net cash proceeds on a pre-tax basis, to be used primarily to reduce bank debt.
The company said the deal is expected to close before the end of the month.
Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.
